description: This file defines React functional components for a custom hover card UI element, utilizing @radix-ui/react-hover-card primitives for accessibility and behavior, and providing styling via the cn utility function.

methods.name: HoverCard
methods.description: A React component wrapping Radix UI's HoverCard.Root, rendering the root element of the hover card.

methods.name: HoverCardTrigger
methods.description: A React component wrapping Radix UI's HoverCard.Trigger, acting as the element that triggers the hover card.

methods.name: HoverCardContent
methods.description: A React component wrapping Radix UI's HoverCard.Content, rendering the content of the hover card with styling and positioning.
